description: This file defines a Mailer class implementing Symfony's MailerInterface, used to send emails within the OrangeHRM application. It acts as a wrapper around Symfony's mailer components, facilitating email delivery with dependency injection of transport.

classes.name: Mailer
classes.description: A wrapper class implementing MailerInterface to send emails, encapsulating Symfony's mailer component via dependency injection.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Mailer with a given transport, creating an instance of SymfonyMailer.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends an email message, optionally with an envelope, using Symfony's mailer.
